gloss: the circumstances; the details of what happened

definitions.gloss: the circumstances; the details of what happened; how things came about
definitions.explanation: Refers to the full sequence of events or circumstances surrounding a situation. Used when explaining or asking for the background of how something unfolded.

examples.japanese: {事|こと}の{次第|しだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
{事|こと}の{次第|しだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、ようやく⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: After hearing the details of what happened, I finally understood the situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{事|こと}の{次第|しだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: I must report the full circumstances to my boss.

notes:
USAGE:
{事|こと} means "matter" or "affair," and ⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧ here means "order" or "sequence of events." Together they refer to the full story of how something came to be. Often used in formal explanations or reports about incidents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事|こと}の{次第|しだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧ (to explain the circumstances)
- {事|こと}の{次第|しだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}する→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧ (to report the circumstances)
- {事|こと}の{次第|しだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to hear the full story)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{経緯|けいい}→経緯：02782_keii⟧: the background, the history — similar but more formal, emphasizes the process over time
- ⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧: circumstances, reasons — focuses on the underlying reasons rather than the sequence of events
- ⟦{顛末|てんまつ}→顛末：21967_tenmatsu⟧: the whole story from start to finish — more formal, emphasizes the conclusion
